replay.detail: Logs the reason immediately before an existing full replay; it neither forces replay on upgrade nor changes its guard conditions. Missing/unhealthy projection health and unsupported incremental claims can still cause the pre-existing fallback before API listeners bind.

schema.detail: No database table, index, trigger or migration change in startup full-replay fallback diagnostics; SQLite user_version is unchanged.

rules.detail: Checkpoint rules and digest/drop policy are unchanged; this change adds no sealing coordination requirement.

compatibility.detail: Startup full-replay fallback diagnostics changes internal execution or build behavior without a new external API/claim version requirement.

downtime.detail: No additional upgrade service stop or measured outage introduced by startup full-replay fallback diagnostics; the standard daemon/client restart procedure still applies.

manual.detail: No data repair or configuration conversion required for existing installations by startup full-replay fallback diagnostics.

recovery.detail: No additional recovery procedure introduced by this change. Preserve graph state, keys and configuration and follow the standard roll-forward guidance; this note does not qualify binary-only downgrade of the whole release.
